concepts.name: Cue — open loop
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a premium original identity exploration for exact brand name "Cue", a personal video platform.
Important user direction: keep a clearly visible right-facing play triangle inside an open circular C-shaped loop, like a playback-loop logo. This is the core idea and must not be replaced by an F, a card stack, an animal, or an abstract unreadable shape.
This variation: exceptionally clean open-loop C, thick smooth rounded circular arc opening at the right, WITHOUT an arrowhead on the loop. One centered solid right-facing play triangle with gently rounded corners. The triangle must be an unmistakable standalone play button, sized generously and optically centred. Refine the proportions, gap, curve endings and spacing so the result feels distinctive, timeless and excellent as a 24px favicon. No queue stripes or extra symbols. Warm, simple, balanced.
Pair it with a carefully drawn medium-bold rounded geometric "Cue" wordmark, beautiful kerning and subtle custom C, but do not put a second play triangle in the letters.
Palette: soft vivid coral #FF765E, warm white #F8F3EE and deep charcoal #111316. Flat solid colours and crisp vector-style curves. No gradients, texture, lighting, shadows or 3D.
Landscape identity board 1536x1024. Upper 65% charcoal, small upper-left label exactly "CUE / OPEN LOOP", one large central horizontal symbol + wordmark and generous whitespace. Lower 35% warm white shows three faithful uses of exactly the same mark: coral symbol alone, black monochrome horizontal lockup, small dark rounded-square app icon. Triangle uses contrasting background or foreground consistently so it is visible in every application. Only text "Cue" and "CUE / OPEN LOOP". No mascots, planets, stock mockups or decorative artwork. Polished professional digital product branding.
Input image role: visual reference for the approved Cue / Loop concept. Preserve its clear internal play triangle and open C-loop idea, while redesigning the surrounding loop and typography according to this variation. The reference is not a request to reproduce the entire old board unchanged.

concepts.name: Cue — next loop
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished new brand logo concept for exact name "Cue", a personal video website.
Mandatory user direction: retain a large visible right-facing play triangle centered inside a simple open circular C-shaped playback loop. The loop and internal play button are the hero. No animals, no card stack, no F monogram.
This variation is a refined forward / next-up version: a bold smooth C-like circular arc, with its upper-right end terminating in one small, carefully integrated forward arrowhead. Make the arrowhead controlled and precise, not oversized or cartoonish; it should feel part of the arc. The lower-right end is rounded and the opening is generous. A single solid play triangle inside, gently rounded corners, generous negative space and optical balance. A memorable premium mark with excellent small-size legibility. No queue stripes, no additional triangles, no multiple arrows.
Wordmark "Cue": beautifully kerned modern humanist sans, medium-bold, lightly rounded with a bespoke e. All letters readable, no symbols inside the lettering.
Colour direction: amber #FFB020 for the loop, warm white #F8F4ED for the internal play triangle and wordmark, midnight #0D1117. Strictly flat solid fills, clean vector-style artwork, no gradients, glow, texture or dimensional effects.
Landscape 1536x1024 brand board. Upper 65% midnight with small upper-left label exactly "CUE / NEXT LOOP" and a dominant centered horizontal icon + wordmark. Lower 35% warm white with three evenly spaced faithful reproductions: amber symbol alone with a dark play triangle for contrast, monochrome black horizontal lockup, dark rounded-square app icon with amber loop and white play triangle. Keep the logo geometry identical across applications. Text only "Cue" and "CUE / NEXT LOOP". Strong professional composition, generous whitespace, video-playback meaning immediately evident.
Input image role: visual reference for the approved Cue / Loop concept. Preserve its clear internal play triangle and open C-loop idea, while redesigning the surrounding loop and typography according to this variation. The reference is not a request to reproduce the entire old board unchanged.

concepts.name: Cue — flow loop
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Design a high-end original logo exploration for the exact wordmark "Cue", a personal video platform.
Mandatory design brief from user: preserve a very clear solid right-facing play triangle inside an open C-shaped circular loop. This same internal play-button idea is the essential feature. Do not substitute an animal, cards, an F, planets or a different symbol.
This variation: a sleek continuous open playback loop that feels gently in motion. Use a smooth C-shaped arc with subtly tapered ends, one small elegant arrowhead at the upper right, and a clean generous opening on the right. Keep the taper very controlled and the silhouette simple rather than a swirling spiral. The solid central play triangle is slightly soft-cornered, large and immediately recognisable. The whole logo should feel precise, light and modern, highly legible at 24px. Exactly one loop, one arrowhead, one internal play triangle. No queue stripes or decorative marks.
Wordmark exact spelling "Cue": elegant geometric sans, slightly lighter and more refined than a heavy gaming logo, meticulously spaced, with rounded bowls and clean terminals. No additional play triangles in letters.
Palette: clear sky blue #78B7FF, cool white #F4F7FC, deep navy-black #0B111B. Solid flat colours, crisp vector-like contours. No gradients, texture, glows, shadows, metallic effects or 3D.
Landscape board 1536x1024. Upper 65% deep navy, small upper-left label exactly "CUE / FLOW LOOP", one dominant centered horizontal logo lockup, generous negative space. Lower 35% cool white with three aligned applications using exactly the same mark: blue symbol alone with dark internal triangle for contrast, black monochrome horizontal logo, small dark rounded-square app icon with blue loop and white triangle. Only text "Cue" and "CUE / FLOW LOOP". Sophisticated, beautifully composed professional identity board.
Input image role: visual reference for the approved Cue / Loop concept. Preserve its clear internal play triangle and open C-loop idea, while redesigning the surrounding loop and typography according to this variation. The reference is not a request to reproduce the entire old board unchanged.
